data.long_meaning: Eylul is a Turkish name that corresponds to the month of September. It is not directly derived from Arabic or Islamic sources. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Turkish. Parents who choose Eylul usually hope their child will grow to embody september in turkish and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_urdu.name: ایلول
in_urdu.meaning: اسلامی تقویم کا نوواں مہینہ، رمضان کا مہینہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: ایلول اسلامی تقویم کا نوواں مہینہ ہے جو رمضان کے نام سے جانا جاتا ہے، یہ مہینہ صوم، خیر اور برکت کا مہینہ ہے، اللہ نے اس مہینے میں قتال کو حرام قرار دیا ہے، رمضان کی اہمیت اسلامی تقویم میں بہت زیادہ ہے کیونکہ مسلمان اسے مغفرت اور رحمت کا مہینہ مانتے ہیں

data.cultural_impact: In Turkey, Eylul is considered a month of harvest thanks to the agricultural roots of the Turkish people. Festivities, such as agricultural fairs and family gatherings, are commonplace during Eylul, making it a time for celebration and connection to one's heritage.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Islamic tradition, Eylul is the month of Muharram and Safar, marking the beginning of the Islamic year according to the lunar calendar. It is also the month in which the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) migrated from Mecca to Medina, making it a significant period in Islamic history. Additionally, many Sunnis observe the Prophet's Night Journey (Al-Isra and Al-Miraj) on the 27th night of this month. Overall, Eylul holds a deep spiritual significance as a time for reflection, migration towards higher meanings, and gratitude for the blessings of the past year.
